caption: The drawing features a single female figure standing and facing forward. She is wearing an elaborate historical dress composed of several layers. The bodice of the dress is light beige or cream, form-fitting with defined seams, and has pinkish trimming along the edge. The sleeves are three-quarter length and end in frills with more pink and green accents. The upper skirt layer is a dark green color, gathered and voluminous, and sits over an underskirt that is light beige with pink vertical and horizontal lines. The hem of the underskirt and outer garments are lined with pinkish coloring, with some green and tan shading. The woman wears a small floral headpiece featuring blue and pink flowers and a decorative necklace. The background is plain and uncolored, focusing all attention on the figure and the details of her attire.
title: Fashion Doll
